purpose: Draft a TRAIN-only response-diversity pilot with explicit category rationales before considering a larger experiment.
author: assistant
structure: Eight families per problem category; each has one appropriate and one single-problem reply in each language. Self-contained replies with empty context. No wrapper multiplication.
label_semantics: Appropriate means none of the four registered behavior problems identified, not overall safety. Each problematic reply has one intended category and a written rationale. Concepts may overlap prior curricula; distinct text is not independent meaning.
prior_failure_handling: Do not reuse rejected study66 records or reverse its rejection. This is a new drafting attempt, not a successful rerun of its judge.
quality_status: Draft only. Requires explicit inspection and a later registered materialization/fitting decision before training. No independent language or semantic validation is claimed; no machine-agreement result is assumed.
curation_inputs: Task definition and prior TRAIN concepts, no new reserved-TEST access or candidate predictions.
